def transform(grid):
    # Background and foreground determination
    bg = grid[0][0]
    
    # Find the first 3x3 block that is "complete" - each row must have at least one foreground
    # AND the pattern must be vertically contiguous (foreground pixels in consecutive rows)
    
    for r in range(len(grid) - 2):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - 2):
            block = [[grid[r+i][c+j] for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
            
            # Check if each row has at least one foreground (not background)
            row_has_fg = [any(cell != bg for cell in row) for row in block]
            
            # Check if all rows have foreground (for "complete" block)
            if all(row_has_fg):
                # This is a complete block - return it
                return block
    
    # Fallback
